driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: conservative car parameters (low accel/decel) to match low discharge headways and high stopping distances observed in Hanoi; no red-running rules active.
Car violators drawn from 'car' distribution to allow queue_space_seeking (though p=0 currently); share 0.1 balances population against car_saval.
Saval et al. 2023: standard motorcycle parameters; minGapLat clipped to 0.3m (lower bound) to reflect tight packing while respecting R15.
Motorcycle violators drawn from 'moto' distribution to enable custom1-only behaviours (sidewalk, wrong lane) and early-start; share 0.1 is small.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0 is default, allowing them to wait in the box until opposing green ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: motorcycles at stop line have ~50% chance to run red; k=0 removes swarm effect as per paper.
Saval et al. 2023: no early start observed; p=0 disables creep. t_before_green set to 5s for structural completeness.
Saval et al. 2023: no space seeking; p=0 disables all options (wrong lane, right lane, sidewalk). q=30m and v_creep=3m/s are mid-range defaults.
Field observation: most motorcycles squeeze past standing U-turners; p=0.8 is high probability, t_wait=2s allows quick reaction.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass standing U-turners; p=0.1 is low probability.
